Apply a data-rich YouTube multitask teacher directly to YouTube Music examples, and distill both serving and auxiliary logits into a small model without requiring source-domain data or matching interface features.
- [SaFRO: Satisfaction-Aware Fusion via Dual-Relative Policy Optimization for Short-Video Search](../../../reproductions/2603.19585-safro/README-en.md): Satisfaction reward models immediate engagement and long-term retention. Dual-Relative PO normalizes advantages within groups and across tasks; relation gating fuses search objectives.
- [GR4AD](../../../reproductions/2602.22732-gr4ad/README-en.md): GR4AD uses multigranularity UA-SID to encode ads, LazyAR to relax dependencies between autoregressive levels, VSL for business-value-weighted supervision, and RSPO to optimize ranked lists directly. Dynamic Beam Serving adjusts beam width with load.
- [S-GRec](../../../reproductions/2602.10606-s-grec/README-en.md): Semantic and revenue objectives may conflict. Instead of adding raw rewards at incompatible scales, A2PO standardizes business and semantic advantages separately inside each rollout group and anchors the update to business advantage.
- [DRL-PUT](../../../reproductions/2509.05292-drl-put/README-en.md): Treat a utility-weight combination as the action. Condition on request/user state and learn from logged propensities and aggregate rewards instead of manually tuning relevance, CTR, CVR, and revenue weights.
- [MPFormer](../../../reproductions/2508.20400-mpformer/README-en.md): Objective tokens drive one sequential retriever across behaviors. Allocate capacity and retrieval quota dynamically by task difficulty.
- [OneRec-V2](../../../reproductions/2508.20900-onerec-v2/README-en.md): Post-training uses actual watch duration and negative feedback. DARS corrects duration bias, and GBPO controls positive and negative gradients with dynamic denominators rather than PPO clipping.
- [SERAL](../../../reproductions/2502.13539-seral/README-en.md): Serendipitous recommendations must be relevant and previously unseen. SERAL compresses very long history into multilevel cognition profiles, uses LLM and human CDI to break the logging feedback loop, aligns SerenGPT with IPO, then generates and caches candidates nearline.
- [LEADRE](../../../reproductions/2411.13789-leadre/README-en.md): It quantizes ads to S-IDs, trains ad semantics and commercial-value auxiliary tasks, then aligns with DPO. Online serving combines a long-term generation cache with real-time serving.
- [BEQUE](../../../reproductions/2311.03758-beque/README-en.md): BEQUE uses rejection sampling and multi-instruction SFT, self-samples rewrites, ranks them on relevance, retrieval increment and hit rate in an offline search system, and learns partial preferences with rank-aware PRO. Serving refreshes rewrites offline and looks them up in a KV store rather than running a 7B LLM per request.

### Causal inference and long-term value
- [From Prediction to Incrementality](../../../reproductions/2608.10182-incrementality/README-en.md): Estimate potential outcomes with and without treatment, rank by uplift and its uncertainty rather than click probability, and allocate causally under a fixed outreach budget. Optimize value added by the action, not outcomes that would happen anyway.
- [SWAG](../../../reproductions/2607.25233-swag-bid/README-en.md): A masked future plan models a seven-day sliding-window objective across episodes. A per-step gate injects long-horizon guidance into the current bid decision.
- [Adaptive Ad Load Design for Sponsored Search Markets: Evidence, Theory, and Deployment](../../../reproductions/2607.14418-adaptive-ad-load/README-en.md): Decide dynamically how many ads to show per search under revenue and conversion constraints. A randomized field experiment estimates the supply curve, then a lightweight policy chooses ad load.
- [Downstream Rewards](../../../reproductions/2607.14192-downstream-rewards/README-en.md): Pinterest proposes and screens candidate downstream rewards offline for their ability to predict future engagement. Reward heads that pass are added as model-agnostic auxiliary objectives across Homefeed, Search, Related Pins, and Notifications without replacing the existing ranker.
- [Causal Retrieval](../../../reproductions/2607.14161-causal-retrieval/README-en.md): Always triggering the shopping candidate generator wastes resources and can over-distribute to users without shopping intent. The paper learns multi-event outcomes and doubly robust uplift from randomized logs, selects a threshold via offline linear replay, and runs online in parallel with remote retrieval.
- [Causal Representation Learning for Generalisable Recommendation](../../../reproductions/2605.27043-causal-representation/README-en.md): Information-theoretic deconfounding keeps causal outcome-related components of candidate representations and removes noncausal components from the exposure policy. There is no extra online inference cost after training.
- [PEARL: Unbiased Percentile Estimation via Contrastive Learning for Industrial-Scale Livestream Recommendation](../../../reproductions/2605.21752-pearl-percentile/README-en.md): Estimate behavior percentiles from multiple comparisons rather than one biased label. Value weighting, bootstrapping, and long-term co-training extend the method to multiple ranking objectives.
- [DADF: A Distribution-Aware Debiasing Framework for Watch-Time Regression in Recommender Systems](../../../reproductions/2605.17863-dadf/README-en.md): Freeze a mature first-stage watch-time predictor. Learn a distribution-conditioned multiplicative residual without changing the scalar serving interface.
- [GrowthGR](../../../reproductions/2605.17994-growthgr/README-en.md): An RQ-VAE SID and decoder-only generator retrieve items. MoPO combines purchase, click, exposure, ranking, and uplift labels with clipped inverse propensity for rare valuable items.
- [PA-Bridge](../../../reproductions/2605.05855-pa-bridge/README-en.md): A distribution aligner transfers passive browsing behavior into the active query space. Semantic discretization and reweighting weaken exposure feedback loops and improve conversation-starter coverage and diversity.
- [A Long-term Value Prediction Framework In Video Ranking](../../../reproductions/2602.17058-ltv-video-ranking/README-en.md): PDQ removes position bias. An attribution module allocates long-term value within a session; creator-period tasks add cross-day value from high-quality creators.
- [Awakening Dormant Users: Generative Recommendation with Counterfactual Functional Role Reasoning](../../../reproductions/2602.13134-rolegen/README-en.md): An LLM reasoner identifies each item's functional role in a conversion trajectory and estimates its instrumental effect via counterfactual paths. Candidates enter an SID-generation backbone and iterate through reasoning, execution, feedback, and reflection to reduce interest collapse for dormant users.
- [Jointly Optimizing Debiased CTR and Uplift for Coupons Marketing: A Unified Causal Framework](../../../reproductions/2602.12972-unimvt/README-en.md): Dual prediction towers and a counterfactual X-Network constrain factual and counterfactual outcomes. Unit uplift puts coupon tiers on one scale.
- [Hierarchical Contextual Uplift Bandits for Catalog Personalization](../../../reproductions/2601.14333-hcub/README-en.md): Sparse child nodes inherit reward from parents to improve cold starts. The policy directly estimates action uplift instead of just fitting observed absolute clicks.

### Multitask learning and joint labels
- [Learned Cross-Task Relationships in Multi-Task Models](../../../recommendation-components/2609.28776-cross-task-relationships/README-en.md): Marginal heads discard joint information. Paired joint labels or missing unconditional auxiliary heads supply shared gradients and downstream policy features; the paper tests these effects separately. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

### Ad attribution and weak supervision
- [Statistical Learning from Attribution Sets](../../../recommendation-components/2602.06276-attribution-sets/README-en.md): Use position priors and binomial tail probabilities to estimate risk and squared-prior weighting for ERM, rather than random or max-prior pseudo-labeling. Implement printed v1 literally and preserve its failed finite-sample identity check. v1 Section 3 Theorem 1 and Section 4.1 Eqs. 6–7. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

### Baselines and incremental debiasing
- [Baseline and Incremental: User, Item, and Request Debiasing in Instagram Feed Ranking](../../../recommendation-components/2610.27423-baseline-incremental/README-en.md): User/item baselines come from historical features and request baselines from the current pool. This is a scoring change, not causal uplift. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

### Advertising and commercial decisions
- [Hierarchical GTV Estimation: Bridging the Gap between Container-Level Ranking and Item-Level Conversion](../../../recommendation-components/2610.32420-hge/README-en.md): The **Hybrid Set-Aware Encoder (HSAE)** models interactions among the top-$K$ items before adding user, store, context and query features. **Proxy-Label Learning (PLL)** separately predicts whether the store converts, the probability of each item's purchase conditional on conversion, and quantity. **Residual Correction and Ensemble Fusion (RCEF)** accounts for value outside the top-$K$ and mixes the corrected estimate with generic store-level regression. A learned gate sets that mix from context per example, not by routing on observed conversion labels. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- [Reinforcement Learning for Controller Parameters in the Auto-Bidding System at Pinterest](../../../recommendation-components/2610.33248-pinterest-rlbp/README-en.md): Separate Q-heads learn relative budget-utilization and CPC outcomes. The system combines them according to the remaining campaign lifetime. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

### Foundation model capabilities in recommendation
- [KL-MOPD: Discrepancy-Aware Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation for Generative Recommendation](../../../recommendation-components/2610.36973-kl-mopd/README-en.md): KL-MOPD first estimates per-position reverse KL to each teacher on prefixes generated by the **frozen initial student**. The discrepancies are normalized once and then held fixed as teacher weights. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Multi-stage ranking and blending

### Real-time sequences and listwise reranking
- [SequenceO1](../../../reproductions/2609.08443-sequenceo1/README-en.md): SequenceO1 compresses distant history to a fixed number of prototypes and retains a recent-behavior branch. STCA combines the two in parallel, controlling cost while retaining long-term interests.
- [POEM](../../../reproductions/2606.29946-poem/README-en.md): Convert relative ranks from several ranking objectives on the current request into partial-order signals. Construct training sequences that better reflect current interests than chronology alone.
- [PIANO](../../../reproductions/2606.16641-piano/README-en.md): The Query-Driven Interest Refiner extracts query-relevant interests from history. The Information Aggregation Node summarizes the entire candidate list and conditions item-level CTR/CVR predictions.

### Coordinated retrieval, pre-ranking, and ranking
- [OneTrans-V2](../../../reproductions/2609.28589-onetrans-v2/README-en.md): History cannot read stage tokens. Each stage token sees only events before the request and not other stage tokens, reusing encoding without future leakage.
- [UniRec](../../../reproductions/2609.11052-unirec/README-en.md): UniRec jointly trains two-stage fusion with partially shared embeddings and separate DCN/Mixer and AutoInt-Lite towers. Downstream preferences supervise upstream training only; they are not online inputs to pre-ranking. v3 retains multi-objective conflicts through CPPA, prunes pairs by confidence with CAPP, and uses within-group AGRR KL to counter distribution drift from attributes such as video length. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- [SPEAR](../../../reproductions/2608.01738-spear/README-en.md): Generic rewrites can win via path-score shortcuts. Dual embeddings and gradient isolation protect retrieval semantics; multiply rewrite confidence by item relevance, then use a dynamic selector for request-specific weight, scale and bias.
- [STEPS](../../../reproductions/2608.01949-steps/README-en.md): STEPS jointly decides whether to push and when to wake next. A planning agent uses gated ordinal regression for intervals, an execution agent decides whether to send based on trajectory return, and a lightweight filter controls computation and blocks abnormal plans.
- [ROCS](../../../reproductions/2607.27744-rocs/README-en.md): User-side features are shared across many candidates. Generalized Layer Masking isolates candidates, Deep Cross Attention defers candidate interaction, and IKBO broadcasts the request representation inside the GPU kernel.
- [OneShot](../../../reproductions/2607.27475-oneshot-index/README-en.md): OneShot learns a hierarchical index with ranking: discrete paths on forward pass, straight-through gradients on backward pass, global path balance against hot buckets, and neural scoring beyond dot product after probing paths. Training joins ranking, indexing and balancing objectives.
- [SlimPer](../../../reproductions/2607.12281-slimper/README-en.md): Each layer revisits raw sparse and sequence tokens, selects relevant evidence, explicitly matches it with knowledge templates, and refines the knowledge base. User tokens are encoded once per request and shared across all candidates.
- [CS3](../../../reproductions/2604.19269-cs3/README-en.md): Independent towers enable ANN but limit interactions. CS3 adds cycle revision and knowledge coordination while preserving offline and online deployability.
- [COBRA](../../../reproductions/2503.02453-cobra/README-en.md): Generate a sparse code, then condition an end-to-end trainable dense vector on it. Use beam search to find codes and refine retrieval by dense neighbors.

### Reranking, blending, and multi-objective page decisions
- [Once Generated, Ranked: End-to-End Generative Slate Recommendation with Unified Semantic-Collaborative IDs](../../../reproductions/2608.17613-ogr/README-en.md): TUSID combines semantic and collaborative codes. GL2P plans the whole slate, then SPA aligns to list-level feedback with conservative policy optimization.
- [DEGR](../../../reproductions/2608.04809-degr/README-en.md): Add squared cosine penalties within a cohort to prevent repeated similar exposures. Exploration feedback adjusts ORPO reward weights, and inference selects greedily with diversity constraints.
- [Twitch Multi-Objective Ranking](../../../reproductions/2608.04455-twitch-mor/README-en.md): **Topic: Multi-objective livestream ranking.** Viewing, interaction, follows and payment arrive at different delays and vary across lifecycle segments. The paper combines immediate and delayed models, segment-specific objective weights and MMoE with shared experts and objective-specific gates.
- [DIRECTOR](../../../reproductions/2607.26418-director/README-en.md): Generate a dynamic-index distribution for each slot and constrain all slots jointly with Sinkhorn optimal transport. Global matching rather than independent argmax reduces conflicts and produces the entire slate in parallel.
- [PSG](../../../reproductions/2607.26427-psg/README-en.md): Generate a half-length pair sequence and expand losslessly. Ordered pair scores and duplicate constraints ensure usable slates.
- [LLM-Based Re-Ranking for Real Estate Search](../../../reproductions/2607.14835-real-estate-rerank/README-en.md): Pass conversational requirements, structured listing attributes, text descriptions, and candidate-set statistics to an LLM reranker. Cross-candidate comparison complements local relevance from vector retrieval.
- [GenPage: Towards End-to-End Generative Homepage Construction at Netflix](../../../reproductions/2606.31031-genpage/README-en.md): Generate the entire homepage with one model rather than cascading retrieval and ranking. After WBC/SFT, RL post-training uses long-term production rewards while handling business rules and cold start.
- [Pinterest Complementary LLM Predictor](../../../reproductions/2605.27856-pinterest-ads-llm/README-en.md): First, SFT predicts one next advertiser. Then GRPO generates 20 advertisers and 5 interests, rewarding the hit position and enforcing output lengths.
- [DeGRe](../../../reproductions/2605.25749-degre/README-en.md): For each prefix, it distills lookahead values of all remaining candidates into dense soft labels. Online only one greedy generator is retained.
- [Memento](../../../reproductions/2605.24051-memento/README-en.md): Data Memento retrieves forgotten but currently relevant training examples for a second replay step. Maximal marginal relevance balances relevance with redundancy; Ember Affine scales and shifts, and Quadratic adds multiplicative interactions.
- [A Production-Ready RL Framework for Personalized Utility Tuning with Pareto Sweeping in Pinterest Recommender Systems](../../../reproductions/2605.16344-prl-puts/README-en.md): A dual-head Q-network estimates Repin and P2P utility. Pareto sweeping filters nondominated policies offline, so serving swaps governed utility weights without replacing the model.
- [GenRec](../../../reproductions/2604.14878-genrec/README-en.md): Item-at-a-time generation ignores complements and ordering on a page. Predict the next page, compress its inputs with an asymmetric merger, optimize group reward, and retain NLL to limit drift.
- [Dual-Rerank](../../../reproductions/2604.07420-dual-rerank/README-en.md): An autoregressive teacher learns item-order dependencies; a non-autoregressive student predicts ranks in parallel. Utility distillation optimizes quality and latency.
- [Constraint-Aware Generative Re-ranking for Multi-Objective Optimization in Advertising Feeds](../../../reproductions/2603.04227-cgr/README-en.md): One network generates the sequence and estimates reward. Encode slot and ad-load rules in autoregressive decoding, and prune infeasible branches early rather than repairing output afterward.
- [Rethinking Multi-objective Ranking Ensemble in Recommender System: From Score Fusion to Rank Consistency](../../../reproductions/2601.02955-harmonrank/README-en.md): Rewrite AUC as a differentiable rank-sum objective to align tasks in ranking space. Then learn dependencies among objectives such as purchases and comments with self-attention to produce one ranking.
- [DRL-PUT](../../../reproductions/2509.05292-drl-put/README-en.md): Treat a utility-weight combination as the action. Condition on request/user state and learn from logged propensities and aggregate rewards instead of manually tuning relevance, CTR, CVR, and revenue weights.
- [SORT-Gen](../../../reproductions/2505.07197-sort-gen/README-en.md): At inference, it builds objective queues such as CLICK, PAY, and GMV and reduces the search from all candidates to queue heads. Mask-Driven Fast Generation records selected items and queue state in tensor masks, evaluating several positions and queues in one batched call.
- [CDM](../../../reproductions/2406.09021-cdm/README-en.md): A controllable MMR teacher generates lists balancing relevance and diversity. Distill contextual marginal gains into a student suitable for low-latency serving.

### Foundation model capabilities in recommendation
- [WeSearch: A Unified Model-Centric Retrieval Framework for WeChat Search](../../../recommendation-components/2611.00530-wesearch/README-en.md): The union retains atomic documents for a coarse-to-fine ranker. The learned OPQ artifacts and rolling index updates matter; random fixed codebooks cannot replace the training pipeline. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

### Training objectives and decision optimization
- [OneTrans-GSR: A Generative Slate Ranking Paradigm Unifying Reranking and Mix-Ranking with One Autoregressive Transformer](../../../recommendation-components/2611.04720-onetrans-gsr/README-en.md): At serving, the system selects the generated slate with the highest accumulated sequence log-probability rather than rescoring all slates with the RM. Hard constraints remain in decoding and soft preferences enter rewards; the method does not remove every rule. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Content understanding, moderation, and risk control

### Content understanding and semantic representation
- [CAMIE: Co-Engagement-Aware Multimodal Item Embeddings for Snap Dynamic Product Ads Retrieval](../../../reproductions/2608.30255-camie/README-en.md): Mine jointly engaged items from user journeys, then use symmetric in-batch InfoNCE to shift content similarity toward behavioral co-conversion. One checkpoint supports both multimodal and text-only retrieval.
- [Multimedia Asset Personalization via Multimodal Embeddings at Netflix](../../../reproductions/2608.18322-netflix-mediafm/README-en.md): Use frozen CLIP/MediaFM representations as shared online features in an asset two-tower model and enhance the search canvas with query similarity. Offline IPS and a winner proxy screen checkpoints.
- [DME](../../../reproductions/2608.02148-dme/README-en.md): After contrastive pretraining, organize evidence with Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning and preserve opposite-side details with Cross-Conditional Reconstruction. Both generation heads are training-only.
- [GALA: Generative Aligned Learning for Adaptive Multimodal Representation in the Taobao Shangou Recommender System](../../../reproductions/2607.29213-gala/README-en.md): Pretrain multimodal representations on query–image–text triples, align them with GRPO and behavioral rewards, then fuse multimodal and ID representations with an adaptive gate.
- [FLUID](../../../reproductions/2605.21832-fluid/README-en.md): The two are separate late-fusion tokens. Candidate IDs are removed through three stages: add slice, remove ID, add room.
- [MM-LLM](../../../reproductions/2605.09338-mm-llm/README-en.md): Item tokens and user-history token profiles join ID and visual features in the production ranker. LLM inference stays off the online critical path.
- [TagLLM: A Fine-Grained Tag Generation Approach for Note Recommendation](../../../reproductions/2603.21481-tagllm/README-en.md): Multimodal chain-of-thought extracts fine-grained tags by interest dimension. Two-stage knowledge distillation transfers tagging to a smaller model for explainability and serving efficiency.
- [PinCLIP](../../../reproductions/2603.03544-pinclip/README-en.md): General VLM training does not match recommendation, and fresh content lacks behavior. PinCLIP combines multigranular image/text signals with Pin–Board graph-neighbor alignment.
- [IDProxy](../../../reproductions/2603.01590-idproxy/README-en.md): Multimodal semantics differ from long-learned collaborative item-ID space. Contrastive coarse alignment precedes multilayer hidden-state proxies, injected into the ranker through a residual gate.
- [RQ-GMM: Residual Quantized Gaussian Mixture Model for Multimodal Semantic Discretization in CTR Prediction](../../../reproductions/2602.12593-rq-gmm/README-en.md): Quantize image/text embeddings in residual stages with Gaussian-mixture posterior soft assignments to improve codebook utilization relative to hard clustering. Train semantic discretization separately from CTR preference modeling.
- [SARM: LLM-Augmented Semantic Anchor for End-to-End Live-Streaming Ranking](../../../reproductions/2602.09401-sarm/README-en.md): An offline MLLM generates livestream semantic anchors, which a lightweight SAE injects into end-to-end ranking. Asymmetric deployment updates only the ranker online to avoid MLLM latency.
- [MIM](../../../reproductions/2502.00321-mim/README-en.md): ID-only models struggle with fresh content. Reconstruct masked multimodal input, align content and collaborative interests with SFT, and fuse content/ID interests with CiUBM.
- [PRECISE](../../../reproductions/2412.06308-precise/README-en.md): PRECISE fuses ID and text at the item level and separates Universal Training (UT), which models interests across scenes, from Targeted Training (TT), which adapts to a sparse target scene or task. To keep strong text representations from starving the ID pathway of learning signal, text tokens are initially frozen while IDs train, then unfrozen for joint training.

### Relevance auditing and data quality
- [LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for DPA](../../../reproductions/2610.14550-snap-dpa-relevance/README-en.md): Clicks are sparse and biased, so offline hit rate alone does not represent user intent. This method compresses user history by semantic ID and event type, trains a student judge using automatically discovered and manually business-aligned relevance criteria, and aggregates scores by user and traffic group. **Not reproduced for now due to cost; validation pending, no executable entry.**
- [ASARL](../../../reproductions/2607.26593-asarl/README-en.md): CriticAgent repeatedly verifies labels and identifies coverage gaps, and GenAgent adds samples in the long tail. The pipeline then runs Social Context Training, Preference-Guided Optimization on interaction signals, and distillation into a small serving model.
- [CORE](../../../reproductions/2607.24417-core-relevance/README-en.md): Valid tokens use clipped GRPO ratios plus reference KL. For low latency, PostCoT logits distill into two conditional BERT heads with BCE and temperature-$T$ distillation.
- [MESH](../../../reproductions/2607.12392-mesh/README-en.md): Separate user, item, and context subtowers and amplify each via residual crossing before global interaction. RGBC gates user–item affinity with context; serving can parallelize subtowers and cache item features asynchronously.
- [Cluster GOOBS](../../../reproductions/2607.00448-cluster-goobs/README-en.md): The paper clusters items by LLM/multimodal embeddings, uses the GOOBS update engine to write into real-time OOB pool segments by cluster, and has the sample engine draw hard negatives from the positive item's cluster with high probability. The online model is unchanged and sampling remains O(1).

### Privacy, policy constraints, and risk control
!!! note "Moderation and risk-control coverage"
    Current implementations primarily cover relevance audits, training data quality, privacy-constrained features, and policy constraints.
    Content safety, fraud and abuse, and ad compliance remain explicit gaps. Relevance models do not fill them.

- [SIRF](../../../reproductions/2609.11752-sirf/README-en.md): Continued pretraining writes complex trigger/exemption rules into model weights. A single verdict and adjustable threshold support decisions on a seconds-scale serving path.
- [RAMP](../../../reproductions/2607.17473-ramp/README-en.md): Privacy choices, permissions and platform limits can hide personalized fields for some traffic. Instead of zero-filling, RAMP maintains personalized and non-personalized paths, selects output with an availability mask, and aligns predictions to distill knowledge from the feature-rich path into the restricted one.
- [UAME](../../../reproductions/2607.17092-uame/README-en.md): Analytical pair probabilities combine pxtr objectives, giving higher weight to more conflicted pairs. Serving uses only the mean, without extending the online path.
- [Causal Retrieval](../../../reproductions/2607.14161-causal-retrieval/README-en.md): Always triggering the shopping candidate generator wastes resources and can over-distribute to users without shopping intent. The paper learns multi-event outcomes and doubly robust uplift from randomized logs, selects a threshold via offline linear replay, and runs online in parallel with remote retrieval.
- [Proximity Features](../../../reproductions/2607.12246-proximity-features/README-en.md): Dense locations split by IP hash; sparse locations progressively merge at coarser geographic precision. Cohort behavior is aggregated daily by stable key without persistent personal identifiers online.

## Serving and research infrastructure

### Feature evaluation and retirement
- [FORTE](../../../reproductions/2610.13806-forte/README-en.md): This is not one-shot feature selection. Adding individual effects does not estimate a joint removal effect: individually redundant features may jointly carry important information, and different heads can disagree on the direction.

### Autonomous research and feedback loops
- [EvoSkillRec](../../../reproductions/2609.34552-evoskillrec/README-en.md): Split a recommender into executable skills with typed inputs and outputs. The controller composes within constraints; only validated innovations advance to the reusable library.
- [EvoPilot](../../../reproductions/2609.21257-evopilot/README-en.md): The protocol fixes the shared base, data version, evaluator, effective output depth, and sole permitted treatment difference. It reads actual run state from artifacts, fails closed on mismatches, and still requires human review before accepting a conclusion.
- [AutoLR: Automating the Path from Research to Launch Review in Industrial Recommender Systems](../../../reproductions/2609.04871-autolr/README-en.md): AutoLR links literature review, proposal debate, implementation experiments, offline evaluation, A/B, and Launch Review in a durable state machine. An LLM reasons over proposals and generates code; a deterministic controller retains ownership of budgets, metric extraction, guardrails, and transitions so noisy wins do not compound through KEEP decisions.
- [CORAL](../../../reproductions/2609.02730-coral/README-en.md): Validate constraints, execute, and write outcomes into the next round's short memory. This is an iterative loop rather than one-shot tuning.
- [RecEvolve](../../../reproductions/2609.01622-recevolve/README-en.md): Propose variants from experiment knowledge and select champions on isolated validation. Version state for rollback and reject reward hacking such as extreme temperature, carrying forward auditable knowledge.

### Serving / efficiency
- [Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems](../../../reproductions/2610.02057-effective-training-time/README-en.md): Decompose wall time into useful training on new data versus lifecycle costs: initialization, compilation, checkpointing, publishing, and recovery. Attribute lost time by owner so it can be addressed.
- [ROCS](../../../reproductions/2607.27744-rocs/README-en.md): User-side features are shared across many candidates. Generalized Layer Masking isolates candidates, Deep Cross Attention defers candidate interaction, and IKBO broadcasts the request representation inside the GPU kernel.
- [Memory Layer](../../../reproductions/2607.25110-memory-layer/README-en.md): Memory Layer makes the cache a sparse model table: the tower writes during training with learning rate one, and downstream and serving read the same representation. A cache miss uses a zero embedding plus always-on attributes such as creator/topic.
- [Prompt Generation](../../../reproductions/2607.11326-prompt-generation/README-en.md): The same interpreter serves training and production; mergers fuse and compress inputs, with parameter-free embedding-space mean pooling a strong default. Event tracking captures online source features for offline replay.
- [NOVA](../../../reproductions/2606.27243-nova/README-en.md): Summarize past changes, diagnostics and outcomes in an architecture gradient. Gate changes through L1 structure semantics, L2 execution, L3 offline effectiveness and L4 online impact; escalate high-risk tasks to humans.
- [RankGraph-2](../../../reproductions/2606.18379-rankgraph2/README-en.md): Online multi-layer GNNs are costly and can overemphasize popular edges. Correct edge popularity, precompute multihop PPR, and compress serving with a jointly learned residual cluster index.
- [EvoRec](../../../reproductions/2606.28368-evorec/README-en.md): EvoRec's Research and Code Agents iterate models. Its Skill Evolver distills reusable methods from persistent memory so both the model and its optimization methods evolve.
- [Pinterest Complementary LLM Predictor](../../../reproductions/2605.27856-pinterest-ads-llm/README-en.md): First, SFT predicts one next advertiser. Then GRPO generates 20 advertisers and 5 interests, rewarding the hit position and enforcing output lengths.
- [UniVA](../../../reproductions/2605.05803-univa/README-en.md): 1. The SID has two semantic levels and one commercial token.
- [CS3](../../../reproductions/2604.19269-cs3/README-en.md): Independent towers enable ANN but limit interactions. CS3 adds cycle revision and knowledge coordination while preserving offline and online deployability.
- [LWGR](../../../reproductions/2605.18771-lwgr/README-en.md): Production precomputes the LLM world knowledge on a seconds-to-minutes nearline schedule and stores it in a user vector store. Requests need one lookup and one cross-attention layer.
- [SIGMA](../../../reproductions/2602.22913-sigma/README-en.md): Inference generates prefixes with beam search and performs ANN only within their subcatalogs. Adaptive probabilistic fusion (APF) trades off precision and diversity according to the spread of prefix confidences.
- [Vectorizing the Trie: Efficient Constrained Decoding for LLM-based Generative Retrieval on Accelerators](../../../recommendation-components/2602.22647-static-constraint-decoding/README-en.md): STATIC compresses a trie offline into CSR transitions, with dense lookup available for shallow layers. Candidate gathering happens on the GPU or TPU at each step, avoiding CPU pointer traversal and device round trips. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- [S-GRec](../../../reproductions/2602.10606-s-grec/README-en.md): Semantic and revenue objectives may conflict. Instead of adding raw rewards at incompatible scales, A2PO standardizes business and semantic advantages separately inside each rollout group and anchors the update to business advantage.
- [OneTrans](../../../reproductions/2510.26104-onetrans/README-en.md): The pyramid stack retains only recent S queries at each layer. Production reuses S-side computation through cross-candidate and cross-request KV caching.
- [OneRec-V2](../../../reproductions/2508.20900-onerec-v2/README-en.md): Post-training uses actual watch duration and negative feedback. DARS corrects duration bias, and GBPO controls positive and negative gradients with dynamic denominators rather than PPO clipping.
- [RADAR](../../../reproductions/2506.07261-radar/README-en.md): Run a full ranker asynchronously after the current request. Cache its high-value items to supplement real-time retrieval on the next request.
- [LONGER](../../../reproductions/2505.04421-longer/README-en.md): Later layers self-attend only over compressed queries. Training uses mixed precision and activation recomputation; serving uses a per-user KV cache.
- [MSD](../../../reproductions/2412.06860-msd/README-en.md): MKIM aligns the distilled student to CTR with LoRA and combines user, target, and history features through adapters. Popular items use precomputed embeddings, low-frequency items and cache misses are encoded online, and fusion uses only the history most relevant to the target.
- [BAHE](../../../reproductions/2403.19347-bahe/README-en.md): During training, deeper trainable layers aggregate cached vectors and predict CTR with the candidate item. The upper sequence is shorter and the shallow stage can update less frequently and asynchronously.
- [BEQUE](../../../reproductions/2311.03758-beque/README-en.md): BEQUE uses rejection sampling and multi-instruction SFT, self-samples rewrites, ranks them on relevance, retrieval increment and hit rate in an offline search system, and learns partial preferences with rank-aware PRO. Serving refreshes rewrites offline and looks them up in a KV store rather than running a 7B LLM per request.
- [M6-Rec](../../../reproductions/2205.08084-m6rec/README-en.md): Option tuning and per-layer option adapters update around 1% task parameters rather than fully fine-tuning M6. Late interaction, early exit, sharing and pruning yield 10M/2M M6-Edge models.

### Advertising and commercial decisions
- [BAFF](../../../reproductions/2609.08725-baff/README-en.md): Training B directly on pooled logs creates treatment interference. BAFF checks where A's ad falls in B's ranking and how its bid differs, retaining A records only when they have approximately no effect on B's decision.
- [PinDCO](../../../reproductions/2609.11943-pindco/README-en.md): PAM penalizes creatives that occupy too many feed pixels by relative aspect ratio. Lightweight filtering, caching and dynamic batching control serving cost, while ε-greedy traffic collects less biased new-creative feedback.
- [CADET: Context-Conditioned Ads CTR Prediction With a Decoder-Only Transformer](../../../reproductions/2602.11410-cadet/README-en.md): A decoder-only Transformer encodes cacheable histories, then injects post-scoring context after candidate scoring to align training with serving and unify ad CTR prediction.
- [ML-DCN: Masked Low-Rank Deep Crossing Network Towards Scalable Ads Click-through Rate Prediction at Pinterest](../../../reproductions/2602.09194-ml-dcn/README-en.md): Replace DCNv2's full-dimensional crosses with low-rank crosses of adjustable internal width. A learned mask selects cross channels, increasing capacity at the same FLOPs.

### Retrieval, triggering, and multi-channel routing
- [Beyond Co-purchase Relation: Evolution of Complementary Recommendations at Allegro](../../../reproductions/2609.05063-allecompanion/README-en.md): ComCat combines expert rules, human feedback, LLM reasoning, and statistical mining to form category relations. A category-constrained two-tower model and Category Adapter limit candidates to plausible complementary categories.
- [SetMIR: Multi-Interest Retrieval as Set Prediction](../../../reproductions/2608.30251-setmir/README-en.md): Decode unordered interests with K learned queries. Hungarian one-to-one matching discourages collapse; presence identifies required interests and query NMS suppresses duplicate ANN requests.
- [CAPTS: Channel-Aware, Preference-Aligned Trigger Selection for Multi-Channel Item-to-Item Retrieval](../../../reproductions/2602.12564-capts/README-en.md): VAM attributes downstream consumption from two-hop retrieved items to the trigger rather than using only trigger-item feedback. CATR jointly routes triggers to I2I channels to reduce overlap and improve complementary coverage.
- [Applying Embedding-Based Retrieval to Airbnb Search](../../../reproductions/2601.06873-airbnb-ebr/README-en.md): Construct positives and hard negatives from the search–browse–book journey, and align first-stage retrieval with traffic replay. Online serving combines HNSW/IVF, geographic filters, and frequent inventory updates.

### Multitask learning and multi-objective optimization
- [FLVM](../../../reproductions/2609.32839-flvm/README-en.md): Measurement confounders enter a restricted baseline; full user/video information enters the latent encoder. Each feedback head reads only relevant factors and adds its logit adjustment to a detached baseline.
- [SMES: Towards Scalable Multi-Task Recommendation via Expert Sparsity](../../../reproductions/2602.09386-smes/README-en.md): Split each task's active experts into a stable subset shared across tasks and an adaptive private subset. Cross-task global load balancing constrains routing, activation count, and expert skew.
- [Towards End-to-End Alignment of User Satisfaction via Questionnaire in Video Recommendation](../../../reproductions/2601.20215-easq/README-en.md): Keep sparse survey satisfaction supervision in its own LoRA path so abundant behavioral labels do not drown it out. Online DPO uses a survey expert as a dynamic reference and updates satisfaction preferences while minimizing disruption to the main ranking backbone.

## Advertising and commercial decisions


### Spatial externalities and allocation
- [Online Advertising with Spatial Interactions](../../../recommendation-components/2602.12481-spatial-ads/README-en.md): The local component implements the paper's grouped pseudo-disk LP relaxation and two-stage randomized rounding, checking group exclusivity and that no selected disk's center is covered by another selected disk. It does not reproduce full matching, live auctions, or the end-to-end factor-18 approximation. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Other industrial components


### Foundation model capabilities in recommendation
- [OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models](../../../recommendation-components/2610.30675-onelatent/README-en.md): Use exploration, evaluation and attribution views to generate adaptive teacher supervision, learn three latent tokens, and serve three-level SIDs without long text. Alignment reconstructs single-view reasons, then multiple views, then predicts next SID from request context. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**

### Retrieval and matching
- [PAIR: Preference-Aligned Intent Retrieval for Premium People Recommendation at LinkedIn](../../../recommendation-components/2610.30941-pair/README-en.md): Train a shared profile/document encoder and short-term history tower from clicks, unclicked candidates in the same exposure and random members. This is multi-negative contrastive learning with exposure-conditioned supervision, not token-level DPO; there is no reference model or KL. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
